mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.0%, it indicates a weak labor market that often precedes economic slowdowns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE > 6.0% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates an environment of uncontrolled inflation without monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with CPIAUCSL > 235 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low housing market (HOUST < 1050) during a period of positive GDP growth (GDPC1 growth > 0.5% quarterly), the economy is in a recovery phase that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low housing market during economic recovery
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with HOUST < 1050 and GDPC1 growth > 0.5% (qtrly) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with INDPRO > 100 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 430,000 million dollars, it indicates weak consumer demand that often precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with RSAFS < 430000 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235, it indicates high inflation that often leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to market volatility and policy concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods with CPIAUCSL > 235 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it reflects sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods with INDPRO > 100 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
